item.title: Trajan Decius, AD 249-251. AR, Sesterce. 14.9 g. 29 mm. Rome.
item.description: Trajan Decius (249-251). AE Sestertius, Rome mint, 249-251. D/ IMP C M Q TRAIANVS DECIVS AVG. Laureate and cuirassed bust right. R/ DACIA. Dacia standing facing, head to left, holding staff surmounted by head of ass. RIC IV 112a; C. 18. AE. 14.9 g. 29 mm. Olive-green patina. VF.
